integrity: Reproducible exact finite enumeration and finite-truncation diagnostics accompany an analytic asymptotic argument. Bibliographic comparisons are bounded; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed random-graph edge probability p in (0,1) as n grows; only annealed mean-width limit; no simultaneous p(n) regime, quenched concentration, or elementary closed expression for c(p) claimed. Classical Gaussian Poisson-extremes theory is used as an input.
title: Poisson extreme-edge gaps and the sharp mean-width deficit of random symmetric edge polytopes
